description.value: The tracking module embeds a specific magical signature on wounds inflicted by the weapon. You can attempt to [[/act track]] a target damaged by your weapon, substituting an Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion check for the Survival check. Much like Tracking with Survival, this must take place somewhere the target has been and follow the trail; it doesn't allow anyone to find the target from a distance. The magical signature wears off after 1 week.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
